text: phenology.thermal_time.x Cardinal temperatures thermal time calculation. Default: c(2, 30, 35) phenology.thermal_time.y Effective thermal time corresponding cardinal temperatures. Default: c(0, 28, 0) phenology.thermal_time.method Method used thermal time calculation. Supported values: "3hr" "HourlySinPpAdjusted". Default: "HourlySinPpAdjusted" phenology.vernalisation_time.x Cardinal temperatures vernalisation time calculation. Default: c(0, 2, 8, 15) phenology.vernalisation_time.y Effective vernalisation time corresponding cardinal temperatures. Default: c(0, 1, 0.5, 0.0)

code: # Get default thermal time cardinal temperatures lentil$get("phenology.thermal_time.x") #> [1]  0 28 35  # Get default vernalisation time parameters lentil$get("phenology.vernalisation_time.x") #> [1]  0.0  4.7  8.0 14.0 lentil$get("phenology.vernalisation_time.y") #> [1] 0.0 1.0 0.5 0.0  # Set custom values lentil$set("phenology.thermal_time.x" = c(0, 25, 40)) lentil$set("phenology.thermal_time.y" = c(0, 25, 0))  # Reset to defaults lentil$reset()
